extracted.intended_audience: Applicants and institutional officials preparing grant applications to NIH and other PHS agencies (PD/PIs, Signing Officials, grants administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and requirements for preparing and submitting SF424 (R&R) and PHS 398 application forms (including multi-project applications) to NIH and other PHS agencies via Grants.gov and eRA Commons. Covers required registrations, form-specific data fields, component-level rules for Overall vs Other Components, ASSIST usage, and pre-/post-submission communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete application composition
rubrics_metrics.description: A complete application to NIH and other PHS agencies will include SF424 (R&R) forms and PHS 398 agency-specific forms; instructions for all SF424 (R&R) and PHS 398 form elements are in this document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this Application Guide as the companion to the SF424 (R&R) form set; applicants must include both form sets when required by the FOA. FOA-specific instructions may supersede or supplement these instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration requirements (SAM, Grants.gov, eRA Commons)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant organizations and PD/PIs must complete required registrations prior to submission: System for Award Management (SAM), Grants.gov, and eRA Commons (including institutional profiles and PD/PI personal profiles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note change from CCR to SAM. eRA Commons registration is required for institutions and PD/PIs to check assignment and review outcomes; provide accurate personal demographic and contact data in Commons. Allow sufficient time for registration/validation before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Funding Opportunity Announcement (FOA) instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must carefully review the specific FOA to determine when to use SF424 (R&R) forms, instructions, and electronic submission requirements for a given activity code and submission type (new, resubmission, renewal, revision).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each FOA includes a link to the most current version of these instructions; applicants are encouraged to check the website frequently for updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover Form required fields and behaviors
rubrics_metrics.description: SF424 (R&R) Cover Form contains specific required fields and new behaviors (e.g., 'Previous Grants.gov Tracking ID' for Change/Corrected Applications; expanded 'Person to be contacted' section; SFLLL label change; new Cover Letter Attachment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover Letter Attachment replaces a separate PHS Cover Letter form; NIH will keep the Cover Letter separate from the assembled application image and only accessible to authorized staff. Ensure required fields are completed (AOR e-mail, DUNS, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget form limits and data integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: R&R Budget Form and subaward budget forms have updated capacity/limits (e.g., Number of Participants/Trainees cumulative limit expanded from 999 to 9,999; Sr/Key Persons increased from 40 to 100; Performance Sites increased from 30 to 300; subaward budget attachments limits increased).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use appropriate Budget Type values (Project vs Subaward/Consortium) and follow ASSIST/Grants.gov behaviors to avoid form-related failures; ASSIST will consolidate subaward budgets into Overall Component summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 form attachments and naming conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 forms have modified attachments and labels (e.g., inclusion/enrollment attachments moved to separate forms; certain Career Development attachments renamed; new 'Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors, and Consultants').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place attachments in the correct, newly-named fields within the application package; double-check that renamed attachments match FOA expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ASSIST for multi-project applications
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST is NIH’s web-based interface for preparing/submitting multi-project applications, accessed with eRA Commons credentials and supporting roles (SO, AO, PI, ASST, AA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST allows federal-wide and agency business-rule validations, automatic TOC/headers/footers/page numbers, preview/print of assembled color PDF images, and component-based assembly. Consult the ASSIST User Guide and FOA for MPA-specific page limits and component types. System-to-system submitters may use equivalent services if available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application assembly order and component planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Assembled application image for Multi-Project Applications (MPA) has a predetermined order: Overall Component first, then Other Components grouped by type (alphabetical), with same-type components ordered by creation sequence; applicants cannot reorder components in ASSIST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan component creation and numbering ahead of time to ensure intended ordering and clear organization in the assembled image. See NIH guidance on image assembly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall Component vs Other Components: field collection differences
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain data items are collected in different detail between Overall and Other Components; Overall Component collects full SF424 (R&R) Cover form fields while Other Components collect only a subset (e.g., Applicant Information, Type of Applicant (optional), Descriptive Title, Proposed Project).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'Expand All' in ASSIST to expose editable fields; grayed-out fields do not require completion in Other Components. Some data (e.g., Applicant DUNS) are pre-populated from Commons profiles and are not editable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project/Performance Sites reporting rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Include only the Primary Performance Site in the Overall Component; list all performance sites that apply to each specific Other Component. A compiled summary of all components' performance sites will be generated in the Overall section upon submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the primary site DUNS is provided (required) and verify that ASSIST preview shows the compiled summary correctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects reporting across components
rubrics_metrics.description: If any component or performance site plans activities involving human subjects, the Overall Component must indicate 'Yes' and the remaining human subjects questions are completed as instructed; Other Components only answer 'Are Human Subjects Involved?' and 'Is the Project Exempt?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Overall exemption is E4, no other exemption numbers may be set for any Other Component. IRB approval date and Human Subjects Assurance Number are completed only on the Overall Component when applicable. See Part II (Supplemental Instructions) for detailed human subjects requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate animals reporting across components
rubrics_metrics.description: If any component involves vertebrate animals, the Overall Component must indicate 'Yes' and complete the related questions; Other Components answer only the 'Are Vertebrate Animals Used?' question.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Items such as IACUC review pending, IACUC approval date, and Animal Welfare Assurance Number are completed only on the Overall Component when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human embryonic stem cell reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions about human embryonic stem cells are completed at both the Overall and Other Component levels, and if any Other Component is 'Yes,' the Overall Component must be 'Yes.' All cell lines from Other Components must be manually entered in the Overall Component cell line table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA and policy guidance for allowable ESC lines and caps (e.g., collection limits updated).

rubrics_metrics.name: Project narrative requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Narrative is required for the Overall Component; Project Narrative is completed at both Overall and Other Component levels but may be optional for Other Components depending on the FOA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the FOA to determine if Project Narratives are required for any Other Components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person Profile rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Only list the Contact PD/PI and any Multi-PD/PIs (roles = PD/PI) in the Overall Component; list all senior/key personnel relevant to each Other Component in that Other Component. The PD/PI role should not be used for personnel in Other Components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide eRA Commons usernames for PD/PIs; for Other Components, unless FOA states otherwise, use Project Role 'Other' with Category 'Project Lead'. Each individual may have one biosketch attached for the entire application (attach once in any component and ensure it reflects participation on each relevant component). Biosketches will not be repeated within the assembled application image.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget preparation for multi-component applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Only the Estimated Project Funding section of the SF424 (R&R) Cover form is included in the Overall component; detailed budgets (including subaward budgets) must be completed for each Other Component. Budget summaries are compiled into the Overall section at submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When collaborating organizations are involved, use appropriate Budget Type settings: For a collaborating organization that is lead of an Other Component, complete the Other Component forms using the collaborating organization's information and use Budget Type 'Project' for subaward/consortium orgs; when the collaborating organization is a consortium/subaward in an Other Component, add an R&R Budget form with Budget Type 'Subaward/Consortium' for that organization. ASSIST will calculate consortium/subaward amounts into the Overall Component.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Application (Resubmission/Revision)
rubrics_metrics.description: For Resubmission and Revision applications, an Introduction to Application is required on the Overall Component and may be allowed for each Other Component unless otherwise stated in the FOA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA-specific guidance on where to place introductions and whether multiple introductions are permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PD/PI leadership plan
rubrics_metrics.description: If more than one PD/PI is specified on the R&R Senior/Key Person Profile form of the Overall Component, a Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The plan is required only at the Overall Component level; it is not applicable to Other Components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not contact reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must never contact reviewers regarding their applications; attempting to discuss scientific content or influence review outcomes breaches confidentiality and is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reviewers are contacted by an applicant they must notify the Scientific Review Officer; applicant contact may delay review or result in return of the application without review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications channels and DRR correspondence
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications from the Division of Receipt and Referral (DRR) are accessible via the eRA Commons 'Correspondence' section; DRR will notify applicants when additional information is required for assignment, when IC assignment requests cannot be honored, or when an application does not comply with NIH policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are responsible for monitoring their eRA Commons accounts for DRR messages and must respond in accordance with the instructions provided. After assignment, contact the Scientific Review Officer for review-assignment questions; after peer review, contact the program official named in the Summary Statement for feedback/funding status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal demographic data collection and privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH collects personal demographic data via the eRA Commons Personal Profile for monitoring equity and compliance with statutory reporting requirements; data are provided one-time, maintained under the Privacy Act record system, and reported only in aggregate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individuals are responsible for true, accurate, and complete data; declining to provide demographic data does not affect application consideration, except where citizenship data is required for program eligibility (e.g., NRSA, K awards). The PHS may request last four digits of SSN for identification, but refusal will not deny rights or benefits provided by law.
